metadata.source_note: Entire 173-page official PDF. Its actual cover and preface identify Stand 2026 despite the legacy da_kg_2024_randstrichfassung endpoint name. The preface describes rules since 2026-01-01 and application to non-final cases subject to explicit temporal restrictions. This capture does not replace DA-KG 2025 or assert blanket applicability to the 2025 certificate period. Expression date records the actual capture date; the edition year is separate metadata. No exact issuance day is inferred from PDF metadata.
